feature.perGroupVolume.label: Independent music / SFX volume
feature.perGroupVolume.message: Lets you set music and sound-effect volumes independently. When off, the emulated audio mix is bit-identical to the original. Turn on to use the separate volume sliders.
feature.miscBugFixes.label: Misc bug fixes
feature.miscBugFixes.message: Turns on every miscellaneous bug fix at once. Individual toggles override it.
feature.gameChangingBugFixes.label: Gameplay-altering bug fixes
feature.gameChangingBugFixes.message: Turns on every bug fix that changes how the game plays. Individual toggles override it.
feature.developerToolsEnabled.label: Developer tools
feature.developerToolsEnabled.message: Turns on developer-only instrumentation. Host-side and purely observational, so it never changes what the game computes. Off by default; leave off unless a feature you use says it needs this.
feature.devNavigationData.label: Navigation data reads
feature.devNavigationData.message: Feeds the Location & Navigation widget, the flood fill, and the simulator with room/grid/sprite reads. Requires developer tools. Host-side and purely observational, so it never changes what the game computes.
feature.extendedRendering.label: Extended rendering
feature.extendedRendering.message: Unlocks the widescreen, tall, and camera options below. Off keeps the original fixed 4:3 view, which is pixel- and timing-identical to the cartridge, so leave it off for vanilla/speedrun parity.
feature.linearWorldTilemap.label: Linear world tilemap
feature.linearWorldTilemap.message: Lets the view go beyond ~16:10 (and enables tall views) by rendering a contiguous world tilemap instead of the wrapping background. Required before ultrawide or tall.
feature.ultrawideRendering.label: Ultrawide
feature.ultrawideRendering.message: Allows aspect ratios beyond ~19:9, up to ~32:9. Requires the linear world tilemap. Changes a lot of what is on-screen, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.tallRendering.label: Tall view
feature.tallRendering.message: Shows more of the map vertically (taller-than-4:3). Requires the linear world tilemap. Changes the on-screen area, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.aspectRatio.label: Aspect ratio
feature.aspectRatio.message: Pick Original for the game width, or choose a fixed, detected or custom screen ratio.
feature.extendY.label: Extend Y (240 lines)
feature.extendY.message: In Original mode, shows 240 lines instead of the stock 224. Other ratios always use 240 lines.
feature.widescreenSprites.label: Widescreen sprites
feature.widescreenSprites.message: Extends sprite spawn ranges so enemies and objects behave as intended in the wider view. On by default when a wide ratio is active.
feature.widescreenVisualFixes.label: Widescreen fixes
feature.widescreenVisualFixes.message: Corrects transitions, effects and sprites that were drawn for the 4:3 screen, in a wide or a tall view. On by default with extended rendering.
feature.cameraLockToViewport.label: Lock camera to the wide view
feature.cameraLockToViewport.message: Removes the black band at area edges in widescreen by resting the view edge on the map boundary. Shifts the rendered camera, which can affect glitch/speedrun timing. Needs extended rendering.
feature.smoothTransitions.label: Smooth area transitions
feature.smoothTransitions.message: Removes the wrapped-edge slice at area boundaries by panning through a 2-area tilemap. Requires camera lock.
feature.widescreenPlayArea.label: Extend the play area to the full view
feature.widescreenPlayArea.message: Extends game activity to the whole widescreen picture instead of only the original 4:3 area: where hazards and enemies spawn, how long enemy spawners stay active, and how much of the view a "room cleared" check considers. Off, the extra width you can see stays inactive. This changes gameplay, so leave it off for vanilla parity.
feature.titleOverride.label: Title screen: reimagined
feature.titleOverride.message: The app draws the title screen itself, from its own scene art, on the same frames as the original. Off keeps the game's own title.
feature.offscreenAI.label: Off-screen enemy AI
feature.offscreenAI.message: Idle: enemies the wider view reveals walk and animate, but will not chase or attack until they reach the original 4:3 screen. Act normally: full behaviour, including attacking you from the edge of a wide view; this is the vanilla-parity option. Freeze: they stop completely until they reach the 4:3 screen. Needs extended rendering.
feature.dimFlashes.label: Dim flashes
feature.dimFlashes.message: Dims bright flashes in the game to reduce eye strain. An accessibility option that does not change gameplay.
feature.allowDiving.label: Allow diving with flippers
feature.allowDiving.message: Lets you duck under anything that would hit you while swimming. Turned on automatically by the extra dungeon, whose water room is built around it.
feature.turnWhileDashing.label: Turn while dashing
feature.turnWhileDashing.message: Lets you turn while dashing instead of committing to the initial direction. Changes how movement feels, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.mirrorToDarkworld.label: Mirror warping to the dark world
feature.mirrorToDarkworld.message: Lets you warp between the light and dark worlds via the mirror (normally unavailable). Changes dungeon progression, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.cancelBirdTravel.label: Cancel bird travel
feature.cancelBirdTravel.message: Lets you cancel bird arrival animations with a button press. Not in the original game, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.collectItemsWithSword.label: Collect items with sword
feature.collectItemsWithSword.message: Lets you collect items (rupees, ammo, etc.) by slashing them with your sword. Changes combat flow, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.breakPotsWithSword.label: Break pots with sword
feature.breakPotsWithSword.message: Lets you slash pots to break them and get their contents, instead of examining them. Speeds up item collection, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.moreActiveBombs.label: More active bombs
feature.moreActiveBombs.message: Increases the bomb count limit so more bombs can explode at once. Not in the original game, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.disableLowHealthBeep.label: Disable low health beep
feature.disableLowHealthBeep.message: Turns off the warning beep when your health is low. Removes an audio cue, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.skipIntroOnKeypress.label: Skip intro on keypress
feature.skipIntroOnKeypress.message: Lets you skip the opening story sequence with any button press. Speeds up fresh game starts, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.disableTelepathy.label: Disable telepathy
feature.disableTelepathy.message: Disables the sage messages that pop up at key story points. Changes pacing, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.carryMoreRupees.label: Carry more rupees
feature.carryMoreRupees.message: Lets you carry more rupees (up to 9999). Changes economy limits, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.capacityProfile.label: Randomizer capacity profile
feature.capacityProfile.message: Set by a randomized profile: a new file starts at the chosen capacity tiers and the pond and wallet stop at the chosen maximums. Changes save bytes and economy limits, so Vanilla Safe strips it.
feature.prizeShuffle.label: Randomizer dungeon prize shuffle
feature.prizeShuffle.message: Set by a randomized profile whose dungeon rewards are shuffled: a boss can hand over any item, and the pendants and crystals are placed like everything else. Changes save bytes and dungeon progress, so Vanilla Safe strips it.
feature.dungeonItemGrants.label: Randomizer dungeon-item grants
feature.dungeonItemGrants.message: Set by a randomized profile whose keys, maps or compasses may leave their dungeons: one found elsewhere still counts for the dungeon it belongs to. Changes save bytes, so Vanilla Safe strips it.
feature.retroBow.label: Randomizer retro bow
feature.retroBow.message: Set by a randomized profile playing retro: arrows are never found or carried, and every shot costs rupees. Changes what firing the bow does, so Vanilla Safe strips it.
feature.pondPlan.label: Randomizer wishing-pond plan
feature.pondPlan.message: Set by a randomized profile whose pond is part of the shuffle: the pond charges its own prices and can hand over any item. Changes save bytes and the pond's economy, so Vanilla Safe strips it.
feature.archeryNeedsBow.label: Archery game asks for a bow
feature.archeryNeedsBow.message: Stops the archery game from taking your money when you have nothing to shoot with. The owner tells you why instead. Not in the original game, which lets you pay and shoot nothing, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.coloredRupees.label: Coloured rupees
feature.coloredRupees.message: Shows rupees waiting in the world as plain coloured gems, a colour for each value, instead of the picture with the amount written beside it. Only changes how they look, never what you get. On by default; not in the original game, so turn it off for vanilla parity.
feature.itemSheen.label: Item sheen
feature.itemSheen.message: Makes items waiting in the world catch the light every second or so, so a pickup on the floor stands out from the scenery. Purely a visual effect. Not in the original game, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.showMaxItemsInYellow.label: Show max items in yellow
feature.showMaxItemsInYellow.message: Shows item counts in yellow when you have the max of that item. This only changes HUD color and does not affect gameplay.
feature.autoSkipDialog.label: Auto-skip dialog
feature.autoSkipDialog.message: Shows dialog text at once and dismisses message boxes for you, including item-get text, without skipping anything that happens when a dialog ends. Yes/no and shop prompts still wait for your answer. Not in the original game, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.dialogControls.label: Dialog pacing controls
feature.dialogControls.message: Speeds up dialog by a multiplier, lets you hold A to go faster still, and lets B finish the current box in one press. Not in the original game, so leave off for vanilla parity.
feature.extendedLetters.label: Every accented letter
feature.extendedLetters.message: Dialog shows every accented letter a translation or a name uses, drawn in the game's own font. Off shows the plain letter instead.
feature.languageScreens.label: Screens follow the language
feature.languageScreens.message: Every screen shows the language's own text, not only the dialog.
feature.jaFileSelectStyle.label: Japanese file select style
feature.jaFileSelectStyle.message: The file select uses the Japanese layout.
feature.prefillFileName.label: Prefill file name
feature.prefillFileName.message: New files start named Link, with the cursor on End.
feature.trackerEnabled.label: Checks tracker
feature.trackerEnabled.message: Lets the checks tracker read inventory and save flags out of the running game. Turning it off stops that polling and the tracker stops updating. Host-side and purely observational, so it never changes what the game computes.
feature.hostMenu.label: Host-owned pause menu
feature.hostMenu.message: Lets the app draw and run the pause menu itself, which is what makes the enhanced menu (gear tiers, the full item grid, bottle slots) possible. The Modern HUD style turns it on for you, so there is nothing to switch here. It replaces the original menu, so leave that style off for vanilla parity.
feature.modernControls.label: Modern control scheme
feature.modernControls.message: Lets you put any item on any button instead of only Y, by having the app set the equipped item as you press. The Modern HUD style turns it on for you, and that style is where your bindings are shown, so there is nothing to switch here. Not in the original game, so leave it off for vanilla parity.
feature.haptics.label: Controller vibration
feature.haptics.message: Vibrates supported controllers and devices on in-game events. It does not change what the game computes, but the notify calls are inserted directly into the vendored game code, so Vanilla Safe forces this off along with everything else that touches it.
feature.medallionSpinAttackAbortFix.mess: Stop spin attacks from cancelling a Bombos/Ether/Quake medallion cast triggered on the same frame.
feature.doubleCameraDoorHandlingFix.mess: Prevent the indoor camera from being nudged twice in one frame (e.g. spin attack between bumpers).
feature.turboDashPitLevitationFix.label: Turbo-dash pit levitation
feature.turboDashPitLevitationFix.messag: Stop turbo-tapping the dash button from letting Link levitate across pits.
feature.walkOnWaterPitStateFix.label: Walk-on-water near-pit flag
feature.walkOnWaterPitStateFix.message: Clear the near-pit flag promptly when leaving a hole so Link can't walk on water.
feature.pitLandingExplorationGlitchFix.m: Disarm the exploration glitch when landing in a dungeon through an access pit.
feature.capeMagicUnderflowFix.label: Cape magic underflow
feature.capeMagicUnderflowFix.message: Prevent the magic meter from wrapping to full when the cape drains your last magic.
feature.capeDrainWhileGrabbingFix.label: Cape drain while grabbing
feature.capeDrainWhileGrabbingFix.messag: Make the cape keep draining magic while Link is grabbing or pulling a wall.
feature.somariaNoMagicPowderFix.label: Somaria empty-magic powder slip
feature.somariaNoMagicPowderFix.message: Stop an empty-magic Cane of Somaria from auto-sprinkling magic powder if you switch items.
feature.somariaMagicRefundExploitFix.mes: Stop the Cane of Somaria from refunding magic it never spent when slots are full.
feature.magicRefundOverflowClampFix.mess: Clamp refunded magic to the meter maximum so it can't overflow.
feature.dashBufferingSlopeFlagFix.label: Dash-buffering slope flag
feature.dashBufferingSlopeFlagFix.messag: Always run slope detection while dashing so the dash-buffering glitch can't trigger.
feature.slopeJudderOobReadFix.label: Vertical-slope judder / OOB read
feature.slopeJudderOobReadFix.message: Fix jittery diagonal-slope movement and an out-of-bounds read in the vertical slope code.
feature.tempBunnyAnimationStepsFix.label: Temp-bunny walk animation
feature.tempBunnyAnimationStepsFix.messa: Use the correct walk animation for the temporary bunny form.
feature.potionModuleDoorTransitionFix.me: Skip door-transition handling when a potion has switched Link into another game module.
feature.linkInitGlitchStateReset.label: Link_Initialize leftover-state reset (bundles 6 fixes)
feature.linkInitGlitchStateReset.message: Reset leftover state on load/continue to close several save-quit, mirror, and bunny-revert glitches.
feature.kikiDefuseBigBomb.label: Kiki big-bomb defuse
feature.kikiDefuseBigBomb.message: Defuse the big bomb when Kiki the monkey re-grabs you, instead of letting it detonate.
feature.zoraSpawnInShallowWater.label: Zora shallow-water spawn
feature.zoraSpawnInShallowWater.message: Let Zoras surface from shallow water (fixes Zoras in Misery Mire that never appear).
feature.mushroomNoPickupDuringMirrorWarp: Don't pick up the magic mushroom while a mirror warp is in progress.
feature.giantMoldormKnockbackSfx.label: Giant Moldorm knockback SFX
feature.giantMoldormKnockbackSfx.message: Play the missing hit sound when Giant Moldorm knocks you back.
feature.noDoubleAbsorptionHandling.label: Double heart/fairy absorption
feature.noDoubleAbsorptionHandling.messa: Stop hearts and fairies from being processed twice when absorbed (fixes double-absorption).
feature.swamolaCorrectSegmentIndex.label: Swamola segment index
feature.swamolaCorrectSegmentIndex.messa: Fix the Swamola index bug that causes Lanmola glitches in Misery Mire.
feature.mothulaTakesL4AndSpinDamage.mess: Let the upgraded sword and spin attack hurt Mothula.
feature.reloadShieldPaletteAfterPikit.me: Refresh the shield's colors immediately after a Pikit steals/returns your shield, instead of leaving it the wrong palette.
feature.cancelHookshotGrabOnHiddenAbsorb: Stale hookshot grab on hidden item
Cancel a hookshot's grab on an item once that item becomes hidden under a rock, instead of keeping a stale grab link.
feature.mothulaSpikeTileDamageClassFix.m: Make Mothula take the correct amount of damage from spike-floor tiles (a fix for an altered internal damage class).
feature.giantMoldormWeaponTinkSfxFix.mes: Play the correct 'tink' sound (with panning) when your weapon bounces off the Giant Moldorm, instead of a missing/silent effect.
feature.boomerangTerminateWhenEmptyHande: Boomerang ends when released early with nothing in hand, instead of getting stuck.
feature.bigBombPreserveFollowerIndicator: A super bomb explosion no longer wipes your active follower state.
feature.permabunnyRestorePaletteOnRevive: Reviving as a permanent bunny restores the correct bunny colors instead of a glitched palette.
feature.fixDeathCounterOvercount.label: Death-counter overcount
feature.fixDeathCounterOvercount.message: Don't count a death when you choose 'continue without saving' on the game-over screen.
feature.fixResumeMosaicSanctuaryWarp.mes: Fix saving/quitting mid-mosaic (e.g. while being electrocuted) wrongly resuming you at the sanctuary.
feature.fixPermabunnyDeathPalette.label: Permabunny death palette
feature.fixPermabunnyDeathPalette.messag: Fix Link showing bunny colors during the death animation when dying as a permanent bunny.
feature.skipRoomTagsDuringStaircaseTrans: Prevents items from spawning in the wrong spot when you step onto a staircase at the same moment a room trigger fires.
feature.skipDungeonUpdateAfterModuleExit: Fixes a corrupted exit when leaving Skull Woods via a Cane of Somaria door button.
feature.kholdstareShellPaletteRange.mess: Fix Kholdstare's frozen shell using the correct palette range during its freeze/melt color fade.
Keep the glove color correct (Power/Titan's Glove tint) when Link's gear palettes are reloaded.
Super bombs no longer teleport back to you as a follower the moment they detonate.
feature.superBombPaletteOnFrameZero.mess: The super bomb keeps its colorful flashing palette on its final frame instead of glitching.
feature.fixPortalMusicRestart.label: Portal music restart
feature.fixPortalMusicRestart.message: Stops the background music from restarting when you step through a portal.
feature.icePortalRevealChime.label: Ice Temple portal reveal chime
feature.icePortalRevealChime.message: Play the discovery chime when lifting the rock that uncovers the magic portal to the Ice Temple (vanilla is silent here).
Hides Link across the full widescreen view (blinking, cape, doorways) instead of only off the normal 4:3 screen.
feature.saveMenuLockoutAfterMedallionFix: Fix save-menu lockout after medallion cast
Fixes being locked out of the save menu when you die right after casting a medallion.
feature.fixBunnyPaletteAfterMap.label: Bunny colors after the map
feature.fixBunnyPaletteAfterMap.message: Fix the bunny keeping Link's mail colors after the map screen closes in the Dark World.
